section: Tall units H. 222 | for base unit H. 78
source_pages: printed p.143 / PDF 145 (subset extracted: p.143 only; the section runs printed p.137-145)
family_naming_note: SAME FAMILY AS tall_h222.json, DIFFERENT SECTION - exactly the relationship tall_h210_base78.json has with tall_h210.json, and for the same reason. The catalog prints these as two chapters with two letter pairs, CG/CH for printed p.132-136 and C3/C4 here, but the physical family is one: 2220 tall on a 100 plinth. This file declares no family-level key of its own.
extraction_note: printed p.143 taken WHOLE 2026-08-25, demand-driven and NOT speculative: Andriy chose H.222 + top H.72 for the Avenida Primavera east wall, which is the combination that reaches a 3048 ceiling with 8 mm to spare, and this is the page that carries that wall's oven-and-microwave column. 3 positions, 4 codes, d.62 only. Verified against a 150-dpi render after pdftotext agreed with it line for line. printed p.137-142, p.144 and p.145 remain unread; their headings are scanned and recorded in _manifest catalog_map.
ladder_note: THE TWO HEIGHTS ARE 120 APART AND SO IS EVERY REMAINDER. printed p.121's oven-and-microwave column leaves 1710 at H.210 and this page's leaves 1830 at H.222; 1515 becomes 1635. The difference is 120 in both, which is the whole difference between the families. That is a consequence of the arithmetic and not a rule read from the page - it is recorded because it makes a future transcription error visible, not because the catalog says it.

Generator.front_stack raises when a stack breaks it.
front_layout.no_shorthand_note: NO heights_mm_top_to_bottom - docs/Reserved_Void_Spec_v0.1.md §4. The shorthand means 'every entry is a front', and here they are not.
front_layout.appliance_opening_note: THE 600 IS MEASURED, AND THIS PAGE IS THE INDEPENDENT WITNESS. printed p.121-122 left exactly 600 six times over from a total of 2100; C42657 leaves it a seventh time from a total of 2220 - 840 + 390 + 390 = 1620, and 2220 - 1620 = 600. A number derived once from one total is arithmetic; derived again from a different total it is a measurement. Still not printed anywhere, and still recorded as a derivation so that an Elda answer contradicting it puts the DERIVATION on trial.

family_keys_note: THIS FILE DECLARES NO FAMILY-LEVEL DATA KEYS, and the omission is enforced rather than chosen: 50_registry.rb merges section files by family and refuses two files that state the same family fact, even when they agree in substance. tall_h222.json owns height_mm 2220, plinth_h_mm 100, depths_mm and collections for family 'Tall H.222'; restating them here cost one run of the suite on 2026-08-25 and the error named both files and the key. Section facts that are NOT family facts live at the top level of this file instead - see depth_note.
